subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) IDH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/011f4492646cc3d5a5dd46c17e657f534c83144880865e6585bbc7322c8c2802.png] 

Option 2) SNQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba960f3e44817054f22daff9c4b6feffad8139297779fd6e51ad07678946c0f.png] 

Option 3) MHK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cae64a2e48e1be99883715939349e303ed4a6cd5a83bbb4f89b7356ac7dd0a14.png] 

Option 4) PKN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dc7169284d8553c50f99f9f756a80d75914693c6fd110b8c8d7689dec629337.png]

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
